spans.s: --(शैनेयस्): beginning with शिनि and ending with Yugandhara. This is the line of Anamitra, a branch of the वृष्णिस्. (क्षेत्रोपेतद्विजस्). M. ४५. २४; Vi. IV. १४. 4; १९. २३.
--one of the २८ hells, where theft is punished; visited by those who do not fulfill vows undertaken and others who do not perform rituals. भा. V. २६. 7; Br.
(II)--the horse of the Sind on which Sud- yumna rode to the northern forests. भा.
(III)--(च्) a kingdom watered by the Sin- dhu; noted for horses. Br. II. १८. ४८; IV. १७. २७; M. १२१. ४७.
(IV)--a disciple of शौनक; again divided the सम्हिता into two parts and gave to मुञ्जकेश. वा. ४७. ४६; ६१. ५३; Vi.
